Sources are unpacked official archives under <vm root>\payload\packages\src (not in the repository; official_url says where each came from). Programs go to C:\Tools, the user's files to C:\Work - ordinary names, nothing that says 'test'. A driver script under lab/case/drivers presses the keys a person would press; it is not part of the evidence.

Each tarball matched the registry's dist.shasum (sha1) and dist.integrity (sha512) on 2026-11-15: typescript-5.1.3.tgz sha1 8d84219244a6b40b6fb2b33cc1c062f715b9e826, sha512-XH627E9vkeqhlZFQuL+UsyAXEnibT0kWR2FWONlr4sTjvxyJYnyefgrkyECLzM5NenmKzRAy2rR/OlYLA1HkZw== | https://registry.npmjs.org/lodash/-/lodash-4.17.21.tgz sha1 679591c564c3bffaae8454cf0b3df370c3d6911c, sha512-v2kDEe57lecTulaDIuNTPy3Ry4gLGJ6Z1O3vE1krgXZNrsQ+LFTGHVxVjcXPs17LhbZVGedAJv8XZ1tvj5FvSg==, sha256 6a087ac9e5702a0c9d60fbcd48696012646ec8df1491dea472b150e79fcaf804 | https://registry.npmjs.org/@types/lodash/-/lodash-4.14.195.tgz sha1 bafc975b252eb6cea78882ce8a7b6bf22a6de632, sha512-Hwx9EUgdwf2GLarOjQp5ZH8ZmblzcbTBC2wtQWNKARBSxM9ezRIAUpeDTgoQRAFB0+8CNWXVA9+MaSOzOF3nPg==, sha256 a1822350520b0055fce3d304a190f617b0e261cd77af64313eb5b1c36f491c9c. Written by hand, not from an archive: package.json (the three exact versions), tsconfig.json (strict false and skipLibCheck false - the bug needs both; target and lib es2021, module commonjs, include src) and src/index.ts (one line: import "lodash";). 1867 files, 42.4 MB.

blender-5.0.1-denoise.note: SHA-256 of the zip equals the line in https://download.blender.org/release/Blender5.0/blender-5.0.1.sha256 (checked 2026-11-15; 5978 files, blender.exe signed by Blender Foundation, signature Valid). 5.0.1 is the last 5.0 release. Samples = the issue's two attachments, bytes unchanged, renamed: sample_attachment 'Memory leak with denoise node compositor.blend' -> product-turntable.blend (the comp), sample_attachment_2 'EXR Generator.blend' -> turntable-plates.blend (the Cycles scene that writes the EXR plates the comp reads from //EXRs, so both must sit in one folder). Both were saved by Blender 4.5 (file header v405) and hold no absolute path. The script is ASCII and uses only calls found in the 5.0 Python API reference (docs.blender.org/api/5.0).

lines: # turntable_job.py - render the turntable plates, then set up the comp that denoises them.
# Used as:  blender -b turntable-plates.blend --python turntable_job.py -o <frame path> -a
PLATES = 4          # plates to render: frames 1..PLATES of turntable-plates.blend -> EXRs\0001.exr ...
LAST_FRAME = 2000   # the comp loops over the plates up to this frame
# 1. the plates, with the file's own settings (Cycles, 1920x1080, 4 samples, multilayer EXR with denoising data)
plates = [os.path.join(folder, "EXRs", "%04d.exr" % n) for n in range(1, PLATES + 1)]
missing = [p for p in plates if not os.path.isfile(p)]
# 2. the comp: Image node (the EXR sequence) -> Denoise (albedo + normal, prefilter Accurate) -> output
image_nodes = [n for n in scene.compositing_node_group.nodes if n.bl_idname == 'CompositorNodeImage']
say("expected one image node in the comp, found %d" % len(image_nodes))
say("comp ready: frames 1-%d over %d plates, the animation render comes next" % (LAST_FRAME, PLATES))
